text: We move flat at the end of November. Decision: we take the flat on Lindenstrasse.
[fixture] Congratulations. Decision: we take the flat on Lindenstrasse. Let us list what has to happen before the move.
Task: give notice on the old flat by Friday.
[fixture] Noted. Task: give notice on the old flat by Friday. The notice period is three months, so it is due now.
